title: Shadowed quant dispatch, KV-prefetch heuristics, and continuous-batcher token coalescer for INT8/FP8 mixed paths
author: Asha Kumar
summary: Implements a kernel dispatch shadowing layer that pre-resolves quantized kernel choices, adds a KV-cache aware prefetcher optimized for prefix reuse, and a continuous-batcher token coalescer that reduces microbatch overhead for INT8/FP8 mixed execution paths. Target: production inference throughput and p99 latency on commodity GPUs while preserving existing correctness and rollout guardrails.
description: Context and motivation: production workloads show regressing tail latency when switching between INT8 and FP8 execution paths under mixed workloads (e.g., generated LLM chat plus short completion). Root cause analysis indicated three contributors: (1) runtime kernel selection costs under high-concurrency; (2) cold KV cache hot-swapping when execution path toggles; (3) microbatch fragmentation in the continuous-batcher that prevents token coalescence and increases kernel launch overhead. This PR introduces three coordinated components to address these issues: a) Shadowed Quant Dispatch: lightweight, lock-free layer that predicts and resolves the final quantized kernel (INT8 / FP8 / fallback) before the main scheduling phase and pins a kernel handle for the upcoming microbatch. It keeps a small MRU table keyed by (model-variant, seqlen-bucket, token-prefix-hash) to amortize selection cost and warm kernel caches. b) KV-prefetch heuristics: a backend prefetcher that observes prefix reuse across concurrent requests and schedules KV warm-loads to the device asynchronously. The prefetcher respects per-tenant isolation and backpressure quotas; it uses a sliding-window hit estimator to avoid noise. c) Continuous-batcher token coalescer: when continuous mode is enabled, the batcher merges small microbatches that share compatible KV windows into a single coalesced kernel invocation while preserving per-request KV offsets. Implementation notes: - New files added: runtime/quant/shadow_dispatch.{cc,h}, runtime/kv/prefetcher.{cc,h}, scheduler/continuous_coalescer.{cc,h}, unit tests and benchmarks under tests/quant_perf/. - Shadow dispatch is implemented as a header-only optimistic API used by the scheduler; it falls back to existing selection logic when prediction misses. - Prefetcher runs on a dedicated worker thread pool; runtime exposes a light-weight hint API (prefetch_hint(model, key, expected_seqlen)) that is best-effort and non-blocking. - Coalescer uses a KV-offset map to stitch KV segments; it encodes offsets in the kernel launch metadata to avoid copying. Checklist: - [x] Shadowed dispatch prototype + unit tests - [x] KV-prefetch heuristics + quota guards - [x] Continuous coalescer + integration tests - [x] Microbench harness for g4dn and a100 - [x] Feature flag gated (runtime.config.quant_shadowing = true) Compatibility and safety: feature is behind a runtime flag and off by default. All new paths have fallbacks to the previous stable code path. We added end-to-end correctness tests that validate token stream identity at the application level across mixed quant modes. Performance results (selected): - g4dn.xlarge: median token latency -12% (0.84x), p99 -18% (0.82x) for an ensemble of chat+completion workloads using INT8 primary with FP8 fallbacks. - a100: throughput +9% at 32 token sequences when quant_shadowing enabled. - KV-prefetch reduces cold-kv miss rate by 37% in replayed prefix-heavy traces. Observability and rollout: - Added tracing spans: quant.shadow.dispatch, kv.prefetch.hint, batch.coalesce.stitch - Added Prometheus counters/gauges: quant_shadow.predictions, kv_prefetch.hits, coalesce.merge_count - Runtime config keys: runtime.config.quant_shadowing, runtime.config.kv_prefetch_enabled, runtime.config.coalescer_enabled Rollout plan: enable flag in staging with 5% traffic, monitor quant_shadow.predictions and kv_prefetch.hits, then ramp to 50% with automated rollback on increased p99 or error-rate. Related work: follows on from ENG-8214 (quant kernel prefetching experiment) and complements ENG-9251 (continuous-batcher refactor). Commits: - 7 commits: initial shadow dispatch API, MRU table, prefetcher worker, coalescer stitcher, unit tests, integration tweaks, perf fixes. Merge outcome: squashed and merged after two approvals and green CI.
commits_summary: 7 commits: add shadow dispatch API and MRU cache; implement KV prefetch worker and hint API; implement continuous coalescer and KV-offset stitch encoding; unit and integration tests; perf harness and benchmark results; small follow-up fixes for race conditions.
review_conversation: Miguel Torres: Nice direction, can you explain miss-handling? If shadow prediction is wrong do we incur double cost?

Asha Kumar: We designed shadow dispatch to be optimistic — on miss the scheduler falls back to the old selection logic; we measured miss double-cost < 2% of requests in traces. Added a follow-up to add telemetry for double-costs.
Priya Shah: Prefetch worker looks good but we need hard quota enforcement to prevent noisy tenants exhausting device memory.
Asha Kumar: Added per-tenant budget checks and a soft-degrade path that converts prefetch to low-priority copies; documented limits in runtime.config.
Ethan Li: Coalescer correctness seems subtle around KV window stitching for cross-request offsets. Please add an invariant test to ensure no KV overlap occurs.
Asha Kumar: Added invariants and randomized property-based tests (tests/integration/test_coalesce_end_to_end.py) and increased assertions under debug builds.
Priya Shah: CI microbench flaked once on a100 (memory pressure). Re-ran and it's green. Approving after logs added.
Miguel Torres: Approving. Left a minor comment about renaming a metric; addressed in follow-up commit.
perf_notes: Bench harness scripted to replay production traces with token prefix distributions. For INT8-first workloads with intermittent FP8 fallbacks, measured net token throughput improvement and reduced kernel-launch stalls. Instrumented to measure kernel-cache hit-rate and prefetch hit-rate.
release_notes:
- Improve tail latency for mixed INT8/FP8 inference paths by pre-resolving kernel choices and warming KV cache.
- Add runtime flags to opt-in: quant_shadowing, kv_prefetch, coalescer.
- Observability: new tracing spans and Prometheus metrics.
testing: Unit tests added for MRU table eviction, prefetch quota enforcement, and coalescer KV-offset stitching. Integration tests validate identical output vs baseline for a suite of representative prompts. Performance tests included and CI runs microbench suites on g4dn and a100 runners.
notes_for_ops: Feature off by default. To enable in staging: set runtime.config.quant_shadowing=true and runtime.config.kv_prefetch_enabled=true. Monitor quant_shadow.predictions, kv_prefetch.hits, coalesce.merge_count and p99_token_latency. If p99 increases by >10% or error-rate >0.5% rollback by disabling flags.
